title: SRE shift handoff and postmortem queue — 2026-05-10
content:
SRE shift handoff notes — May 10, 2026

High-level summary:
- This doc captures the on-call handoff, incidents observed during the week, SLO status and error-budget consumption, open postmortems, immediate action items, and short-term risks for infra and serving. Intended audience: eng-sre, platform-engineering, and on-call responders.

Incidents this week (summary)
1) INC-4521 — Tokenizer service 5xx spike (2026-05-07 09:12 UTC)
   - Impact: ~10% increase in 5xx for text-tokenize endpoint across hosted API region-us-west for ~12 minutes; ~2.3% of requests retried by clients. No data exfiltration.
   - Root cause (preliminary): regression introduced in tokenizer v1.4.0 (third-party lib) that caused excessive memory churn and transient OOM on a pod under moderate concurrency.
   - Mitigation performed: rolled back tokenizer service to v1.3.2 (hotfix), increased pod replica count by +2 for immediate headroom, added a temporary circuit-breaker to reject extremely large single-request inputs.
   - Customer impact: brief increased latency and errors for some real-time apps; no prolonged outages.
   - Current status: incident resolved and in progress to write postmortem. Owner: Miguel Santos. Jira: INC-4521.

2) INC-4550 — KV-cache cold-start latency spike during rollout (2026-05-09 02:40 UTC)
   - Impact: Model-serving tail latency spiked (p95 → p99) for ~22 minutes during a multi-cluster rollout of model-serving v3.1.
   - Root cause (investigating): race in cache invalidation + synchronous prewarm disabled in the canary job. Some requests fell back to disk-backed path, increasing token generation latency.
   - Mitigation performed: paused rollout, force-canary to 10% only, applied a pre-warm initialization job, reverted cache invalidation change.
   - Current status: service stable; follow-up action items assigned to Riley Chen to add automated pre-warm in the rollout pipeline. Jira: INC-4550.

SLO / Error budget snapshot
- Primary API availability target: 99.95% (monthly).
- This week (rolling 30d window as of 2026-05-10): 99.87% → error budget used: ~28% of monthly budget.
- Tokenization endpoint SLO: currently at 99.70% (below target due to INC-4521); mitigation roadmap in place.
- Action required: we need to cap risky deploys for next 72 hours and reduce non-essential scheduled maintenance until error budget consumption drops below 20%.

On-call handoffs (today)
- Outgoing shift: Miguel Santos — handoff completed at 2026-05-10 08:45 PDT. Key notes: INC-4521 assigned, rolling restart of tokenizer cluster planned tonight (low-traffic window).
- Incoming shift: Jordan Brooks — starts 2026-05-10 09:00 PDT. Contact methods: Slack @jordan.brooks, PagerDuty level-1.
- Secondary on-call: Riley Chen (SRE lead) — escalation for infra and rollout issues.
- Handoff artifacts: on-call checklist updated (link in linked_artifacts).

Open postmortems / docs queue
- INC-4521: in-progress, owner Miguel Santos; target draft by 2026-05-12; include timeline, root cause analysis (tokenizer regression), mitigation, test coverage added, and rollout gating.
- INC-4550: postmortem template created, owner Riley Chen; need to collect traces and rollout logs (infra-logs: log-agg-20260509).
- Backlog ticket: PMT-1307 — consolidate cache warming patterns across clusters (assigned to infra-tools).

Action items (short-term, owners)
- A1: Finalize INC-4521 postmortem and publish to Confluence (Miguel Santos) — due 2026-05-12.
- A2: Add automated pre-warm job to rollout pipeline and add a canary-metric gate for kv-cache warm-up (Riley Chen) — prototype due 2026-05-14.
- A3: Add a unit+integration test in tokenizer CI that simulates high concurrency memory stress (Jordan Brooks) — PR referenced: infra#1189.
- A4: Temporarily increase synthetic traffic to critical routes by 20% to catch regressions pre-rollout (on-call + observability) — owner: SRE rotations.

Runbook and runbook changes
- Updated: tokenization runbook — added steps for safe rollback, temporary circuit-breaker toggle, and memory-usage thresholds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1189.
- Needs review: rollout gating doc for model-serving (adding prewarm stage). Draft in confluence (link in linked_artifacts).

Planned maintenance / changes
- Planned kernel/security patch on dedicated pools: 2026-05-14 02:00–04:00 UTC. Impact: scheduled disruption to private clusters for a rolling kernel upgrade; Dedicated customers with pinned capacity will be notified.
- Action: SRE to coordinate low-traffic maintenance windows and run a dry-run on staging. Owner: platform-engineering (cc: eng-sre).

Observability and telemetry notes
- Traces: need higher retention for tokenization traces for detailed postmortem (increase from 7d → 14d for the tokenization service). Proposal ticket: OBS-224.
- Alerts: adjust p95 → p99 alert thresholds for model-serving tail latency to reduce alert noise but keep p99 escalation.
- Synthetic checks: add a synthetic for extreme input lengths to catch tokenizer regressions (owner: DX team).

Capacity, cost & risk
- Short-term: GPU pool usage for dedicated clusters is steady at 84% — monitor for 90% threshold where autoscale lag becomes visible.
- Risk: simultaneous large rollouts across regions can amplify cold-cache effects (INC-4550). Mitigation: region stagger in rollout orchestration.

Notes for leadership / requests
- Recommend a temporary soft freeze on non-critical infra deploys for the next 3 business days to preserve error budget.
- Ask product to defer any high-traffic feature launches until error budget drops under 20%.

Next SRE sync / meetings
- Weekly SRE sync: 2026-05-12 10:00 PT — agenda: postmortem reviews, SLO remediation plan, rollout gate roadmap. Attendees: eng-sre, platform-eng, product-ops.

Misc (notes-to-self style)
- Remember to attach heapdumps and flamegraphs for INC-4521 in the postmortem folder.
- Check with supply-chain about tokenizer 3rd-party upgrade cadence (is there an LTS policy?).
- Follow up on linear L-3301 for runbook automation.

End of handoff notes.
